calibration.coefficient_constraints: lambda_A and lambda_D are nonnegative; schedules are continuous piecewise linear, shared across rounds, and clamped at the 64-ply anchor
calibration.one_se_rule: greatest smoothness with mean source-match-grouped CV loss no greater than the minimum mean plus the source-match-cluster standard error of the minimum-loss model
persist: lambda_A and lambda_D at every anchor
semantic-core and conditional-draw threshold lower bounds for every fixed ratio band
nested grouped-CV assignments, selected smoothness, design rank, condition numbers, and model-lack checks
per-fit solver convergence and IRLS iteration counts

controller.candidate_zero: literal complete-move argmax of the normalized suit-symmetrized policy
controller.decision: a nonzero move must be the unique adjusted leader and must clear candidate zero, every higher joint semantic complete-move prior rival, every higher P_A rival, and every same-core higher-P_D rival on raw positive primary and fresh paired deltas; primary and fresh must select the same move
controller.exact_terminal: the intrinsic exact one-card solver runs before policy-cost selection and is not a fitted exception
controller.legacy_actors: all pre-v5 actor families and parser semantics remain byte-identical

policy.normalization: fail closed unless the full legal joint policy is finite, strictly nonnegative, and normalized before aggregation
policy.P_A: sum normalized joint policy over every legal complete draw source sharing the semantic played-or-discarded card core; physical wager identities are collapsed
policy.P_D: joint semantic complete-move mass divided by P_A for its draw source; physical wager identities are collapsed

controller.runtime_scope: real roots only; never recursive continuation nodes

evidence.raw_stage_barrier: every expected immutable raw artifact, sidecar, hash, count, binding, and zero-cap check for a stage must validate before any result-dependent operation or downstream stage

execution_protocol.compile_once: preflight builds and tests every native executable exactly once; every later job downloads and SHA-256 verifies the same transport
execution_protocol.launch: one non-forced attempt-1 push adding exactly the previously absent execution addendum to agent/correctness-and-policy-upgrade

numpy_runtime.install: reducers only, from the sealed local wheel with --no-index --no-deps

execution_protocol.prerequisite_evidence_transport: retain and terminal-reopen the canonical Objective-3 result plus every SHA-256-listed evidence member
execution_protocol.python_runtime: Python 3.12.3 on ubuntu-24.04, checked fail-closed in every job

prerequisite.rule: execution cannot be prepared until objective-3 v2 attempt 32721800280 is terminal, independently verified, and persisted; if it promoted use its objective-3 actor/table and full-match-hybrid TRAIN truth, otherwise retain the verified 800+800 actor and use current-round-margin TRAIN truth

probe_firewall.exclusion_key: information-view suit orbit: public history/features, mover hand, round, within-round nply, cumulative score, and deck count; never opponent hand or hidden deck; physical wager identities collapsed
probe_firewall.order: reject an exact-17 orbit before census denominator, policy classification, reservoir priority, allocation, search, or truth labels

reservoirs.allocation: hash-only before search or truth labels; sparse cells fail without refill, regeneration, widening, replacement, or top-up
reservoirs.allocation_output_order: selection membership is unchanged and outcome blind; TRAIN writes quota-rank-major over a diagonal permutation of all 864 cells, while SELECT/TEST write quota-rank-major over a three-ply-band interleave of all 144 base cells, so fixed evaluator slices span rounds and ply regimes
reservoirs.pre_efficacy_barrier: all TRAIN, SELECT, and TEST discovery reservoirs plus their hash-only allocations must be complete, immutable, and SHA-256-bound before any evaluator opens a search panel or requests a truth label
reservoirs.native_reservoir_origin_proof: before the pre-efficacy barrier opens, the frozen source-free policy_cost_dataset binary scans every retained row in all three reservoirs; it requires the exact 174-byte native information view, source bounds, view validity, recomputed state and suit-orbit hashes, exact17 exclusion, and recomputed policy masks/cell identity, then emits a sealed proof that terminal verification independently reruns byte-for-byte
reservoirs.burned_source_seeds: 1..200, maintained-800 seed 1, 202611010101, and every 20261129 feasibility-smoke seed

candidate_masks.master: enumerate once at 1%; candidate zero is always first and every 1%-eligible core among the true top three aggregate semantic action cores is retained; when candidate zero's core is outside that top three it is an additional mandatory comparator, leaving room for at most one (otherwise at most two) safe conditional-draw variants; maximum width five
candidate_masks.candidate_zero_outside_top_three: candidate zero never displaces a true top-three core and is not counted as shortlist widening
candidate_masks.nestedness: 2% is a no-refill mask of the exact 1% master; prove for every collected state before efficacy

discovery.monolithic_split_jobs: required unless a separately reviewed global-priority/state-chain shard merger is frozen before execution

reservoirs.pooled_nply_ge_64: census only, minimum occupancy zero, excluded from TRAIN/SELECT/TEST weighting; whole-actor safety/final remain authoritative for natural tails

truth.controller: exact policy-20 full-remaining-match continuation on hidden-information-safe fixed worlds

select_and_test.allocation: 64 complete max-five vectors per each of 3 rounds x 24 ply strata x frontier absent/present base cells; partition those 64 deterministically and as evenly as possible among census-feasible candidate-slot J=0..K-1 subcells
select_and_test.candidate_slot: SHA-256(split seed,state hash) mod master width
select_and_test.source_matches: remain source-match clusters even when one generated match contributes more than one selected state

train.weighting: one equal-weight state/pair per globally distinct source match; primary and fresh rows share one independent truth row

bootstrap.simultaneous_method: max-t over all predeclared directed configuration contrasts

selection.metric: discovery-post-stratified full-match hybrid gain over the information-view maintained actor move
selection.rule: an earlier onset must have a strictly positive simultaneous incremental LCB over its immediate later same-floor parent; 1% must have a strictly positive simultaneous incremental LCB over the same-onset 2% parent; among statistically tied eligible configurations prefer performance first, then later onset, then 2%
selection.truth_support: exact untruncated fixed master union plus the maintained actor-selected move even when outside new support
